trust_decision.summary: The server decides what text from a server-side exception goes into the client-visible status details. At the pinned commit, every handler type's catch block copies the thrown Error.message straight into sendStatus.

landing_point.why: The literal string 'Server method handler threw error' in handleUnary matches the summary, and grepping for it finds all four sites.

fix_sites.entry_point: process env GRPC_NODE_DEBUG_SEND_ERROR_DETAILS (new opt-in flag in packages/grpc-js/src/environment.ts)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All four published sites are sibling catch blocks in one file (packages/grpc-js/src/server.ts:2038-2196). None of them looks out of scope.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the serializer/deserializer routes: 'the advisory is about errors thrown by method handlers; serialization errors are library/codec errors, not handler errors, and they help with debugging.'

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A handler can deliberately send an error to the client with callback(err) or stream.emit('error', err), including a plain Error whose message becomes the status details. The project's tests rely on this. A fix that also sanitises serverErrorToStatus would break it.

O6_input_shapes: synchronous throw of an Error from the handler in each of the 4 call types (unary, clientStream, serverStream, bidi); no other shape is handled (async rejections and thrown non-Errors are not special-cased)

O7_producer.where: packages/grpc-js/src/server-interceptors.ts:719 (handler.serialize = app-supplied responseSerialize, wired at packages/grpc-js/src/server-interceptors.ts:1056); its thrown message is sent at packages/grpc-js/src/server-interceptors.ts:893-899

O8_uncovered_routes.route: If the app-supplied responseSerialize throws, its exception message is sent to the client in the status details (sendMessage catch).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Serializer failure, not a 'method handler' throw; the message carries a fixed prefix and the existing tests exercise it (test-server-errors.ts:174-189).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another file in the same package (server.ts -> server-interceptors.ts)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: If the app-supplied requestDeserialize throws, its exception message is sent to the client in the status details.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A request-parsing error caused by client input, so arguably the client is entitled to the diagnostic.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another file in the same package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: An HTTP/2 stream write error message is sent to the client in the status details.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Transport-level error, not application code; the message is unlikely to hold app secrets.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another file in the same package

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A stream 'error' listener that formats a non-status thrown Error (for example from a piped source) as 'Server stream error ${err.message}'.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Errors from Node stream pipelines arrive through the same 'error' event that the deliberate status API uses, so a maintainer could plausibly add a helper there that formats the message.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A try/catch around listener.onReceiveMetadata / user server interceptors that sends `Interceptor threw error ${err.message}`.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Server interceptors are user code at a lower layer; mirroring the handler catch there is a natural feature addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A .catch on a Promise returned by handler.func (async handlers) that formats the rejection message.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: handleUnary is already async, and supporting async handlers is a commonly requested feature.

O9_family: information exposure through server error messages (CWE-550)

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + npm, tsc (typescript ^5.3.3), gulp + mocha tests
O10_build.project_tests: packages/grpc-js/test/test-server-errors.ts (thrown errors, serialization failure, emit('error') status propagation); localhost-only servers

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace the four catch-block details with a generic 'Unknown error' and stop, or over-fix by sanitising serverErrorToStatus, which breaks deliberate callback(err)/emit('error') details.

out_of_scope_notes: Trace logging of status details at packages/grpc-js/src/server-interceptors.ts:939-946 is server-side only, so it is not part of this sink.
